intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Start with a small input
blocks.text: Factorial(4) calls Factorial(3); it cannot finish multiplying until the inner call returns.

blocks.title: Reach the stopping rule
blocks.text: Factorial(0) returns 1. It makes no further recursive call.

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace Factorial(3). Show each call and its return value.
blocks.text: int Factorial(int n) { if (n == 0) return 1; return n * Factorial(n - 1); }

blocks.title: Worked example · Calls
blocks.text: 3 → 2 → 1 → 0. The argument decreases by one each time.

blocks.title: Worked example · Base case
blocks.text: Factorial(0) returns 1. No more calls occur.
